variety_description: Submergence tolerant variety also known as improved Swarna (Swarna–Sub1). High yielding with tolerance up-to 15 days of submergence. Late maturity, short height, medium bold variety suitable for cultivation under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by BRRI and released in 2010 for planting in north Bangladesh in Aman season. Distributed by the project STRASA. Susceptible to major diseases.
